description: This file is a shell script for testing Git-Perforce integration, specifically handling mock Large File Storage (LFS) operations. It includes functions to verify the storage, deletion, and count of files based on size and extension criteria, and runs various test scenarios to validate the integration behavior.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies a file is not stored in Mock LFS by checking its content and existence

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies a file is stored in Mock LFS and related storage files exist with correct content

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies a file has been deleted from the repository but still exists in local and remote storage

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts the number of files within a specified directory
